title: Pablo Neruda's birth chart
metaDescription: Pablo Neruda's chart, computed from a sourced birth date: Sun at 19.9° Cancer. Birth time unknown, so no houses or rising sign.
lede: Six of the ten placements whose signs are settled stand in Cancer — the Sun, the Moon, Mercury, Venus, Mars and Neptune. The placements whose signs could change with an unknown hour are not counted. A cluster that size becomes the section the rest of the chart plays around.

blocks.title: Where the Sun actually stood
blocks.text: 19.9° of Cancer is the Sun's exact seat — second decan, 10°–20°, sub-ruled by Mars in the old triplicity scheme. The degree is the address; the sign is only the street.

blocks.title: The personal registers
blocks.text: The personal planets sit Mercury at 23.1° Cancer, Venus at 21.1° Cancer, Mars at 8.1° Cancer. Mercury in a water sign reads as thought steeped in tone and memory; Venus in a water sign reads as attraction that works by atmosphere; Mars in a water sign reads as effort that surges when it matters.

blocks.title: The angles that hold
blocks.text: The tightest geometry in the chart puts Jupiter a third of the circle apart from Uranus, 0.8° off exact. A third of the circle is the tradition’s friendliest distance — same element, shared assumptions, no translation required. Behind it, the Sun conjunction Venus at 1.2°, and Saturn trine Pluto at 1.2° — both still well inside the orbs this site uses. The unknown hour cannot unmake any of this: every aspect named survived all twenty-five samples of the day.

blocks.title: The standing structure
blocks.text: The Moon makes no major aspect that survives the day; the old reading gives such a planet autonomy — it acts alone, sometimes loudly.

blocks.title: The classical map
blocks.text: The dignity table, which predates the outer planets and only ever spoke for seven, marks three placements here. The Moon in Cancer at 12.6° is in domicile — the planet in its own sign, running on home rules; Mars in Cancer at 8.1° is in fall — the tradition’s uphill placement, strength earned rather than given; Saturn in Aquarius at 19.7° is in domicile. Dignity is a statement about conditions, not about worth.

blocks.title: The shape of the whole
blocks.text: Counting only the 10 placements whose signs hold for the whole day, the chart runs 6 water, 2 fire, 2 air by element and 7 cardinal, 2 mutable, 1 fixed by modality. A water emphasis reads as porousness: the room is registered whole, long before it is analysed in parts. No settled placement falls in earth — an absence the tradition treats as information, not as a defect. Saturn and Uranus were retrograde — motion that reverses only from this vantage point, and which the old reading treats as delay used for revision.

blocks.title: The Moon, and how far it can move
blocks.text: The Moon stayed in Cancer for the whole of that day at the birthplace, covering 14.5° between midnight and midnight. Fast enough that its degree is approximate, slow enough that its sign is not in doubt. At the noon reference it stands at 12.6°.
